body.zh-Hant: 1890年9月29日生於布拉格近郊的皇家葡萄園區（Královské Vinohrady），出身裁縫家庭。1908年在維諾赫拉迪的實科中學畢業，1908至1911年在布拉格的捷克技術學院修讀測量工程；1911至1914年受雇於一家公司，在奧匈帝國各地（主要是波士尼亞）從事鐵路工程。
body.en: Alois Eliáš was born on 29 September 1890 in Královské Vinohrady near Prague into a tailor's family. He graduated from the Vinohrady Realschule in 1908 and studied land-surveying engineering at the Czech technical university in Prague from 1908 to 1911. From 1911 to 1914 he worked for a firm on railway construction in various places of the Austro-Hungarian monarchy, chiefly in Bosnia.

citations.quote: * 29. 9. 1890 Královské Vinohrady (Praha)
Pocházel z rodiny krejčího.
1908 maturoval na vinohradské reálce
1908–11 vystudoval zeměměřické inženýrství
na české technice v Praze
1911–14 pracoval u firmy ing. Maxe Píchy na železničních stavbách
v různých místech rakousko-uherské monarchie, především v Bosně.

heading.en: First World War, the legions and the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 1914年7月第一次世界大戰爆發後他應召入奧匈軍隊，8月31日在俄國戰線被俘；1917年7月加入捷克斯洛伐克軍團，10月隨運輸隊前往法國，在西線擔任軍官。1919年1月以上尉身分返國，1921至1923年就讀巴黎高等軍事學院；1924至1929年任總參謀部組織處處長，1929年起晉升為准將。
body.en: He was called up into the Austro-Hungarian army in July 1914, and was taken prisoner on the Russian front on 31 August. In July 1917 he joined the Czechoslovak legions, and in October 1917 he left for France, where he fought as an officer on the Western Front. He returned home as a captain in January 1919, studied at the war college in Paris from 1921 to 1923, headed the organisation department of the General Staff from 1924 to 1929, and was a brigadier general from 1929.

citations.quote: Hned po vypuknutí první světové války v červenci 1914 narukoval
zde již 31. 8. zajat.
V červenci 1917 vstoupil do československých legií v Rusku
v říjnu 1917 odešel s transportem legionářů do Francie
V lednu 1919 se v hodnosti kapitána vrátil do vlasti
1921–23 vystudoval vysokou školu válečnou v Paříži.
1924 až 29 sloužil jako přednosta organizačního oddělení hlavního
od 1929 brigádní generál

heading.zh-Hant: 旅長、師長、軍長與日內瓦裁軍會議
heading.en: Brigade, division and corps commands; the Geneva disarmament conference

body.zh-Hant: 1931至1933年他在霍穆托夫指揮一個步兵旅，1933至1935年任駐利托梅日采的第3師師長，1935至1938年任駐特倫欽的第5軍軍長，並於1936年起授中將銜（divizní generál）。1932年1月至1933年7月他同時擔任捷克斯洛伐克代表團的軍事負責人，出席日內瓦的裁軍會議。
body.en: From 1931 to 1933 he commanded an infantry brigade in Chomutov, from 1933 to 1935 the 3rd Division in Litoměřice, and from 1935 to 1938 the V Corps in Trenčín; he held the rank of divisional general from 1936. From January 1932 to July 1933 he also headed the Czechoslovak military delegation at the disarmament conference in Geneva.

heading.en: Entering government after the Munich crisis

body.zh-Hant: 慕尼黑危機期間他進入政界：1938年9月30日至11月30日在國防部擔任部長錫羅維將軍的代理人。1938年12月1日起出任交通部長，隸屬第二共和國最後一屆內閣；德國佔領後，他仍在同一部門留任保護國第一屆政府的成員，直到1939年4月底出任保護國總理。
body.en: During the Munich crisis he entered politics: from 30 September to 30 November 1938 he worked briefly in the Ministry of National Defence as deputy of the minister, General Syrový. From 1 December 1938 he was Minister of Transport in the last government of the Second Republic, and after the German occupation he stayed in the same portfolio as a member of the first government of the Protectorate until he became its prime minister at the end of April 1939.

heading.en: Prime minister of the Protectorate government

body.zh-Hant: 1939年4月27日至1941年9月27日他擔任保護國政府總理；政府頁還記載他自4月27日起奉命主管內政部，至7月1日止。傳記辭典寫道，他在總統哈查支持下推行維護保護國自治與捷克民族利益的「積極防禦」政策，一面對占領者保持外在忠誠，一面與國內抵抗組織「國防聯盟」（Obrana národa）合作，也與倫敦流亡政府保持聯繫。
body.en: From 27 April 1939 to 27 September 1941 he was chairman of the Protectorate government; the government's page also records that from 27 April to 1 July 1939 he was entrusted with running the Ministry of the Interior. The biographical dictionary says that, with the support of President Hácha, he pursued a policy of active defence of the Protectorate's autonomy and of Czech national interests, combining outward loyalty to the occupiers with cooperation with the domestic resistance organisation Obrana národa and contact with the exile leadership in London.

citations.quote: 27. 4. 1939–27. 9. 1941 vykonával úřad předsedy protektorátní vlády.
pověřen řízením ministerstva vnitra (27. duben 1939 – 1. červenec 1939)

s vojenskou odbojovou organizací Obrana národa

body.zh-Hant: 1941年9月27日，即海德里希抵達布拉格當天，總理埃利亞什在帝國保護國官邸被捕；10月1日他在一場短暫的審判中以叛國等罪名被判死刑。判決一度暫緩，他被當作人質關押；海德里希遇刺後，他於1942年6月19日在布拉格的科比利西射擊場被處決，成為唯一被納粹處決的被占領國官方代表。
body.en: On 27 September 1941, the day Reinhard Heydrich arrived in Prague, Prime Minister Eliáš was arrested at the Reich Protector's seat, and on 1 October he was sentenced to death for high treason and related charges in a short trial. Execution of the sentence was postponed and he was held as a hostage; after the assassination attempt on Heydrich he was executed on 19 June 1942 at the Kobylisy shooting range, the only official representative of an occupied country executed by the Nazis.

body.zh-Hant: 卡爾·亞爾馬·布蘭廷1860年11月23日生於斯德哥爾摩。他1877年進入烏普薩拉大學，主修天文學，1879至1880年及1882至1884年在斯德哥爾摩天文台任助理，但沒有取得學位。1884年起為報紙《時代》（Tiden）撰稿，1886年轉入《社會民主報》（Socialdemokraten），同年9月14日起擔任該報編輯。
body.en: Karl Hjalmar Branting was born in Stockholm on 23 November 1860. He entered Uppsala University in 1877 and studied astronomy without taking a degree, and worked as an assistant at the Stockholm observatory in 1879-80 and again in 1882-84. From 1884 he wrote for the newspaper Tiden, in 1886 he moved to Socialdemokraten, and from 14 September 1886 he was its editor.

heading.en: Rise in the Social Democratic Party and the Riksdag

body.zh-Hant: 布蘭廷1889年4月起進入社會民主黨黨部，從1897年起一直擔任第二院議員直到逝世，1906年起並任社民黨議會黨團主席。1907年1月17日，他出任黨執行委員會主席，成為黨的領袖。丹麥的Lex條目稱他1907年才正式成為黨主席，並說他從一開始就走改革主義路線，自1880年代後期起已影響了瑞典工人運動。
body.en: Branting sat on the Social Democratic party board from the first party congress in April 1889 and was a member of the second chamber of the Riksdag from 1897 until his death; from 1906 he chaired the Social Democratic group in the Riksdag. On 17 January 1907 he became chairman of the party's executive committee. The Danish encyclopedia Lex calls him the party's formal chairman from 1907 and says he had shaped the Swedish labour movement since the late 1880s, following a reformist line.

heading.zh-Hant: 聯合政府財政大臣與戰後外交
heading.en: Minister of finance and post-war diplomacy

body.zh-Hant: 1917年社民黨與自由黨組成聯合政府，布蘭廷出任財政大臣，任期自1917年10月19日至1918年1月5日。他1918至1920年任瑞典國家銀行（Riksbanken）的受託人，1919年擔任伯恩國際社會主義者會議的主席，並於1919年4月11日成為瑞典出席巴黎和會的代表。
body.en: In 1917 the Social Democrats joined the Liberals in a coalition government with Branting as minister of finance, a post he held from 19 October 1917 to 5 January 1918. He was a bank trustee (bankofullmäktig) in 1918-20, chaired the Internationale conference in Bern in 1919, and became Sweden's delegate at the Paris peace conference on 11 April 1919.

body.zh-Hant: 布蘭廷1920年3月10日首次出任首相，同年10月27日下台，這是瑞典第一個純社會民主黨政府。1921年10月13日他再度組閣，並兼任外交大臣，直到1923年4月19日；1924年10月18日第三次也是最後一次出任首相，1925年1月24日因病獲准卸任，但仍保有閣員身分。
body.en: Branting became prime minister for the first time on 10 March 1920 and left office on 27 October 1920, heading Sweden's first purely Social Democratic government. He formed a second government on 13 October 1921, also serving as foreign minister until 19 April 1923. On 18 October 1924 he became prime minister for the third and last time, and on 24 January 1925 he was released from the premiership, keeping his seat in the cabinet.

heading.en: League of Nations, the Nobel Peace Prize and death

body.zh-Hant: 布蘭廷是國際聯盟的熱心支持者，1920至1924年是瑞典在國聯的代表，1923年起成為國聯理事會成員；他1921年與挪威人朗格共同獲得諾貝爾和平獎，1922年率瑞典代表團出席熱那亞會議。他於1925年2月24日在斯德哥爾摩去世。
body.en: Branting was a keen supporter of the League of Nations: he was Sweden's representative at the League from 1920 to 1924 and a member of the League Council from 1923. In 1921 he shared the Nobel Peace Prize with the Norwegian Christian Lange, and in 1922 he led the Swedish delegation at the Genoa Conference. He died in Stockholm on 24 February 1925.

people.name: Marģers Skujenieks
people.nameZh: 馬爾蓋斯·斯庫耶涅克斯

body.zh-Hant: 馬爾蓋斯·斯庫耶涅克斯1886年6月22日生於里加，出身拉脫維亞知識分子家庭，父親是詩人兼記者。他在1905年革命中參與活動，1906年被迫流亡倫敦；回國後，1907至1911年在莫斯科求學，專攻統計、歷史與拉脫維亞的國民經濟，雖未完成正式高等學歷，後來卻成為第一共和國重要的統計學家與政治工作者。
body.en: Marģers Skujenieks was born in Riga on 22 June 1886 into a Latvian intellectual family; his father was a poet and journalist. As a participant in the 1905 revolution he was forced to emigrate to London in 1906. After returning home he studied in Moscow from 1907 to 1911, concentrating on statistics, history and the national economy of Latvia; he did not complete formal higher education, yet became an important political worker and statistician of the first Republic of Latvia.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰時統計、國民議會與統計局
heading.en: Wartime statistics, the People's Council and the Statistical Bureau

body.zh-Hant: 戰爭期間他組織了拉脫維亞難民救濟中央委員會的統計部門，1917年當選為維澤梅無地農民委員會成員。德國佔領期間他參加主張獨立的民主集團；1918年11月17日他主持人民議會（拉脫維亞的前身議會）的創立會議，被選為議長察克斯特的第二副手，次日又與其他愛國者在民族劇院宣布拉脫維亞獨立。1919年國家統計局成立，他被任命為局長。
body.en: During the war he organised the statistics department of the Latvian refugees' central committee, and in 1917 he was elected to the Vidzeme landless council. Under the German occupation he joined the democratic bloc that stood for an independent Latvia. On the evening of 17 November 1918 he presided over the founding session of the People's Council, the proto-parliament, and was elected second deputy to its chairman J. Čakste; the next day he was among those who proclaimed sovereign Latvia at the National Theatre. In 1919, when the State Statistical Bureau was established, he was appointed its director.

body.zh-Hant: 1926年12月17日，國家元首察克斯特致函議會，邀請議員斯庫耶涅克斯組閣。內閣名單上他自任總理兼內政部長，拉伊尼斯（Jānis Rainis–Pliekšāns）任教育部長，齊倫斯（Fēlikss Cielēns）任外交部長；這個內閣在歷史上被稱為「左派政府」，聯盟由社會民主黨人、中左派團體與少數民族議員集團組成。特賴斯教授寫道，他在1920年代末與1930年代初兩度擔任總理（1926至1928年；1931至1933年）。
body.en: On 17 December 1926 the head of state, J. Čakste, wrote to the Saeima inviting the deputy M. Skujenieks to form a cabinet. He took the posts of prime minister and interior minister himself, Jānis Rainis-Pliekšāns became education minister and Fēlikss Cielēns foreign minister, and the cabinet entered history as the "left government", a coalition of Social Democrats, left-centre groups and a bloc of minority deputies. Professor Rihards Treijs writes that he was prime minister twice, at the end of the 1920s and the start of the 1930s (1926-1928; 1931-1933).
